Ask-GKPSP — Project Knowledge Chat
Namaste! Main Ask-GKPSP hun — instrument readings, sections, ya project details ke baare mein poochho.
AI API Key (this session only)
Yeh key sirf is browser tab ki memory mein rehti hai (sessionStorage) — file/GitHub repo mein kabhi save nahi hoti. Tab band karne ke baad dobara daalni hogi.
Firebase Connection Monitor
Checking connection...
Live status from Firebase's .info/connected — real, not simulated.
Agar connection kate, writes background mein queue ho ke connection wapas aate hi retry hote hain — Firebase SDK yeh khud handle karta hai.
Data Integrity Guard
Yeh purane recurring bug ko target karta hai — khaali array real data ko overwrite kar deta tha. Test karo:
AI Error Diagnosis
Koi error message ya console log paste karo, AI Hinglish mein explain karega kya hua aur kaise fix karein. (Suggest karta hai, khud code nahi badalta.)
Koi diagnosis abhi tak nahi chalayi gayi.
Realistic Limits — Please Read
  • AI diagnosis suggest karta hai, code khud silently badalta nahi — safety-critical monitoring mein har fix manual review ke baad hi apply karo.
  • API key browser mein direct daalne se network tab mein dikh sakti hai — yeh personal/single-user tool ke liye theek hai, lekin agar site public/shared ho to server-side proxy behtar hoga.
  • Firebase reconnect genuinely automatic hai (SDK feature), lekin agar Firebase server-side hi down ho to yeh usse fix nahi karega.
Bulk Data Upload — CSV Import
Data logger se export ki hui CSV seedha upload karo — manual copy-paste ki zaroorat nahi. Abhi Load Cell, Strain Gauge, MAT, TRT, aur Rock Bolt support karta hai (yeh sab similar 3-channel format share karte hain).
Expected CSV columns (with header row):
Load Cell/MAT/TRT/Rock Bolt: Instrument_ID, Date, Ch1, Ch2, Ch3, Notes
Strain Gauge: Gauge_ID, Date, Value, Notes

Google AI Studio Key (FREE)

aistudio.google.com pe Google account se sign in karo → left sidebar me "Get API key" → "Create API key" dabao. Koi credit card nahi chahiye. Key "AIza..." se start hogi, wahi yahan paste karo. Ye key sirf is browser ke localStorage me rehti hai, kabhi HTML/GitHub me nahi jaati.

Proxy URL (CORS fix — one-time setup)

Gemini API browser se direct call nahi hone deta (CORS). Ek free Cloudflare Worker banao (10 min, koi card nahi) — uska URL yahan daalo. Steps ke liye Claude se "Cloudflare Worker kaise banau" pucho.
